text:
maria: Heads up — noticed a gap in hourly aggregates for 2025-11-08 02:00-04:00 in EU. Alerting showed late ingest but replay didn't cover an entire shard.

dan: ugh, which shard?

maria: shard-eu-7. replay job ID `replay_20251108_02_shard7`. logs show `KVCacheMiss` spikes and then job aborted on a transient quota error.

priya: quota error = 429 from billing-proxy or internal rate limiter?

maria: internal rate limiter. console shows we hit per-tenant backfill slot cap. It tried to auto-fallback to low-priority lane but routing didn't honor the canary override.

amit: that's the rollout UX we patched last week right? The console toggle for "enable priority override for backfills"?

maria: yes — toggle flipped on the UI but the API call failed with 502 from config-service at the time of job start.

zoe: can we just re-run that single shard with bumped concurrency and bypass quota? e.g.:
```
replay-run --job replay_20251108_02_shard7 --lane priority --concurrency 8 --bypass-rate-limiter
```

priya: bypass-rate-limiter needs an approved exception id. We can create one but need SRE signoff for the window.

amit: SRE, can you give a 30m exception for replay window? low blast risk, single shard. cc @zoe @maria

replay-bot: Incident 2025-11-08-27 created: request for quota-exception (shard-eu-7). Please add justification.

maria: justification: late EU ingest spike due to upstream S3 partitioning delay. Single-shard recompute to restore dashboards and downstream alerts. Will monitor token consumption and abort if > 15% above baseline.

dan: two quick asks: 1) confirm the console flip actually persisted in config-service or if we need to re-trigger. 2) Add a small UX improvement — show API config state next to toggle and retry option when config-service is unhealthy.

zoe: agreed on UX. I can file a tiny ticket: Console shows current effective config (from config-service) and a red/amber/green since-last-sync indicator.

amit: SRE approved 30m exception — created by ops in incident ticket. Priya, can you re-trigger the replay with the exception id `EXC-2025-11-08-27`?

priya: kicking it off now. command: `replay-run --job replay_20251108_02_shard7 --lane priority --concurrency 8 --exception EXC-2025-11-08-27`

replay-bot: replay_20251108_02_shard7 started. streaming logs at https://replay-logs.internal/replay_20251108_02_shard7

maria: watching logs — KVCacheMiss still high early but batching warmed after 3 minutes and tokens/second stayed within 12% of expected. no errors.

zoe: can we add a guard in the replay API: if config-service returns 5xx, fallback to a cached config and annotate replay with "cached-config" flag so console shows stale config source?

amit: +1. that would avoid the mismatch between UI toggle and actual behavior. small patch in replay-orchestrator: try cached config for up to 5m if config-service unavailable.

dan: also followup: add a telemetry metric `replay.config_source` (values: live, cached, missing) and expose in console replay panel. helps debug in future.

priya: replay finished. status=COMPLETED. downstream aggregates updated. dashboards refreshed. Closing exception.

maria: thanks. Action items: 1) zoe to file console UX ticket for config-state and retry (small). 2) amit to PR cached-config fallback + metric. 3) dan to add replay.panel metric in console. 4) priya to paste replay job debug snippet into incident ticket.

zoe: filing ticket now: https://source-ticket/PLT-8791 "Show effective config + sync status on backfill UI"

amit: opening PR: https://git.internal/replay-orch/pulls/412 — implements cached config fallback + emits `replay.config_source`.

dan: console change request opened: https://git.internal/console/pulls/901 — adds metric panel and a small snackbar when config mismatch detected.

maria: cool. let's also add an alert: `replay.config_source==cached` for > 5m to page oncall so we don't silently run with stale configs.

priya: noted. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
